opus-5-5.intro: The snapshot shows stronger task outcomes and more executable builds. The diagnostic profile is mixed, so the overall lead should be read alongside the component metrics and selected case evidence.

findings.title: Higher task success and progress
findings.body: Opus 5.5 leads the evaluated models in both task success and task progress. Together, these metrics capture not only whether a task is completed, but also how far execution proceeds. The selected cases illustrate these differences in practice, rather than represent the full test set.
findings.label: Task performance

findings.title: More executable worlds
findings.body: Opus 5.5 achieves the highest build rate among the evaluated models, producing executable worlds more consistently. However, a world that runs successfully may still fail to reproduce the intended interaction. Evaluating build rate and task success separately distinguishes executable environment construction from successful task execution.
findings.label: Executability

findings.title: Similar geometry, different outcomes
findings.body: Scene, shape, and size errors are similar across the two models, yet task outcomes can differ. In the desk-leg insertion case, Opus 5.5 succeeds while Fable 5.1 fails despite achieving a slightly lower scene error. Geometric accuracy alone does not fully explain task performance.
findings.label: Geometry vs. outcome

findings.title: Not all metrics show improvement.
findings.body: Despite stronger overall results, Opus 5.5 scores lower than Fable 5.1 on fixed-reference task success (8.6% vs. 11.4%). Fixed-reference progress is equal at the reported precision, while terminal translation errors remain similar. These results suggest that its gains do not extend uniformly across all evaluation metrics.
findings.label: Diagnostic limits

limitations: The five featured cases were selected from 24 Opus-success/Fable-failure pairs among 222 shared cases. They illustrate specific differences rather than overall performance.
This collection does not include verified Opus 5.5 failure cases and therefore cannot characterize its failure modes.
Final outcomes do not capture how agents use feedback or recover from errors. Evaluating these behaviors requires iteration logs.
Complete run configurations and score coverage are not available in the current results. Sample sizes vary across metrics.

gemini-4-argon.intro: Gemini 4 Argon is being tested. Its report will connect the verified metric profile to actual case outputs after the evaluation is complete.
limitations: No verified result is available yet. Ranking, strengths and weaknesses remain unreported.
evidence_priorities: Executable builds: build rate, coverage and examples of both runnable worlds and build failures.
Task completion: success and stage progress, supported by verified successful and failed rollouts.
Physical fidelity: geometry and dynamics metrics linked to the same source videos and model outputs.
Feedback and recovery: iteration logs showing what the agent changed after feedback; this claim requires evidence beyond final scores.
Comparable setup: exact model and agent settings, evaluation version, instance manifest and per-metric coverage.
